soundness_flags.label: thm:causal-specialization and ass:bounded-outcomes
soundness_flags.one_line: The theorem quantifies over the declared arbitrary d>0 although P_{m,h} has Y in {1/2,3/2}; for d<3/4 consistency plus 0≤Y(t)≤2d makes the compatible-completion class empty, contradicting the stated nonemptiness.

soundness_flags.label: prop:scale-equivariance
soundness_flags.one_line: As defined, b, k, a_m, h, L_m(h), and U_m(h) are normalized quantities with no d-dependence, so multiplying Y and its support cannot algebraically multiply the displayed endpoints without an explicitly defined scaled experiment and scaled endpoint map.
